patch_description: Combine the best two components from prior generations: (1) the binary-search-on-threshold first-fit-decreasing feasibility check (Gen 5, score 25.69) as the core, and (2) a targeted worst-pair rebalancing pass targeting the top-2 highest-KVPR GPUs with both move and swap moves (up to 200 iterations, strict-improvement acceptance). The binary search yields a strong feasible placement whose max KVPR is near the achievable threshold; the rebalancing pass then attacks the single worst GPU directly, which greedy-family refinements showed is the most effective local move. Also try multiple model orderings in the feasibility check to strengthen it, and use best-fit selection among feasible GPUs instead of pure first-fit.
